Rahul —

Quick engineer-to-engineer note and a short local checklist so your team can hit the ground running. I attached three small artifacts to this thread: redwood-sdk-quickstart.zip (sample apps and README), auth-diagram.png, local-test-checklist.md.

Local sandbox quick hits (Python & TypeScript)
- Python: pip install redwood-sdk (or unzip quickstart)
  Example auth (local API key):
  export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-test-...
  python examples/python-sample-app/run_chat.py --model gptx-small

- TypeScript: npm install @redwood/inference-sdk
  Example env: 
  export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-test-...
  NODE_ENV=development node examples/ts-chat-sample/dev_server.js

KMS-backed token exchange (pattern)
- Your staging service obtains a short-lived session token from BrightPath KMS. Then call our /v1/token-exchange endpoint with the signed assertion. We return a scoped short-lived SDK key that is auditable and logs request origin. (See attached auth-diagram.png)

Batching & embeddings rerank guidance
- For ~25k queries: we recommend batching at 64–256 vectors per request depending on average dimension; run a small cost sweep locally (script in quickstart) to find the sweet spot.
- For rerankers, run a two-stage approach: cheap embedding filter (approximate nearest neighbors) + model-based rerank for top 50 candidates. We included a small Python notebook under examples/embeddings_rerank/ that demonstrates timings and token counts.

Minimal Dockerfile (local dev) — put in examples/docker/Dockerfile:
FROM python:3.11-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY examples/python-sample-app /app
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt
CMD ["python", "run_chat.py"]

Inbound IPs/domains to allowlist
- *.redwood.ai (API), storage.redwood.ai (artifact downloads)
- 34.207.12.45 (sample quickstart CDN IP) — we’ll confirm if that becomes a static range for your account.

Attachments in the quickstart
- examples/python-sample-app/run_chat.py (sample usage)
- examples/ts-chat-sample/dev_server.js (local TS dev server)
- examples/embeddings_rerank/notebook.ipynb (demo)

If you want, Aditya can join the Mar 28 call to walk through the token-exchange flow live and help you stitch the KMS exchange.
